evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "you only pay for the actual time use... only pay for the minimum" (pay-less concept hit) — other Save Your Ass lines not covered.

top_strength: The only call in this batch with a clean, explicit quid pro quo opener ("I just need a few minutes... so we'll be able to give you an on-target estimate") — a strong, replicable model.
coaching_note: Explicit close ask was made well but the customer deferred — a "does that feel fair" pause paired with silence before the ask might have converted the hesitation into a same-call yes.
